stem: Nathu La Pass is situated in which state ?
expl: Nathu La is a mountain pass in the Himalayan region situated at a height of 4310 m (14,140 feet) above sea level. On the Indian side, the pass is 55 km east of Gangtok, the capital of Sikkim and opens in to Chumbi Valley in Tibet. Nathu La is one of the three open trading border posts between India and China, the others being Shipki La in Himachal Pradesh and Lipulekh in Uttarakhand.

stem: Which of the following Passes lead to Leh?
expl: Zozila Pass is a high mountain pass in Ladakh located on the Indian National Highway-1 between Uri and Leh.

stem: Zoji-la Tunnel will connect which of the following places ?
expl: The Zoji-la Tunnel is an under-construction tunnel in the Kargil district of the Union Territory of Ladakh & Jammu and Kashmir, India. It is located on the Srinagar-Kargil-Leh highway beneath the Zojila Pass between Ganderbal (Jammu and Kashmir) and Drass in Kargil. This tunnel is being constructed to connect Srinagar (Kashmir Valley) and Leh (Ladakh) and will provide all-weather road connectivity between the two regions.

stem: What are Kingri-Wingri, Neeti-Mana?
expl: Kingri-Wingri and Neeti-Mana are passes located in Uttarakhand. Neeti is an important pass of the Himalayas that connects Uttarakhand to Tibet.
